knowledge_graph.title: Apple Watch Series 10
knowledge_graph.description: Apple Watch Series 10 is a smartwatch with a bright OLED display, sleep tracking, water resistance to 50 meters, and up to 18 hours of battery life. Core features work without a subscription.

answer_box.title: Apple Watch Series 10
answer_box.snippet: The Apple Watch Series 10 offers 18-hour battery life, sleep tracking, and 50m water resistance. No subscription is required for core features.

organic_results.title: Apple Watch Series 10 - Apple
organic_results.snippet: Apple Watch Series 10 features an 18-hour battery, sleep tracking, and water resistance up to 50 meters. No monthly subscription required.

organic_results.title: Apple Watch Series 10 review
organic_results.snippet: The Series 10 adds sleep apnea detection and a brighter display. Battery life is rated at 18 hours.
